Name: Sosipater, Kinsman of Paul
Summary: Sosipater was a kinsman of Paul who sends greetings in Romans 16. He is listed separately from Sopater of Berea, since the letter does not identify them as the same man.
KeyStory: Sosipater was a kinsman of Paul who sends greetings in Romans 16. He is listed separately from Sopater of Berea, since the letter does not identify them as the same man.
LifeLesson: Faithful kinsmen stood with Paul to the end of his letters.
